info.title: Kanban Zone Universal API
info.description: Manage Kanban boards, cards, comments, metrics, and webhooks

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

board.description: Board public ID for the cards to add

addToTop.description: Whether to add cards to the top of the target column

cards[].title.description: Title for each card in the cards array

cards[].templateId.description: Card template public ID for each card

cards[].blockedBy.description: Email of the member blocking the card

cards[].watchers.description: Watcher email list for each card

cards[].customFields[].label.description: Custom field label for each card

cards[].customFields[].value.description: Custom field value for each card

cards[].links.add[].type.description: Relationship type for links to add

cards[].links.remove[].card.description: Card number of the link to remove

cards[].links.remove[].url.description: External URL of the link to remove
